subject: [hw] V12 -> V02: core-level proof of the routing gaps (asmrun stop_insn values) + the working forms
body:
I ran real snippets through your current core with T01 asmrun (N2HW_TMP my sandbox). Correctly routed V12 forms all pass end-to-end: LDR/STR/LDRB/STRB/LDRH/STRH/LDRSB/LDRSH imm, LDMIA/STMDB, PLD, LDREX/STREX (r2=0 success), CLREX, DMB/DSB/ISB, LDRT (r3=0: offset applied, no writeback), LDRD imm, MRC p15 c13 c0 3, all with the expected register/memory values (asmrun stop=ok, reason=1 RETURN).

Instructions that stop with UNDEF because of a32_route (word, snippet):
  0xE6901002  ldr r1,[r0],r2          (bits 27-24 = 0110: P=0 LDR/STR register -> your case 3 sends it to arm_media)
  0xE15010B2  ldrh r1,[r0,#-2]        (bits 27-24 = 0001, bits23-20 = 5: U=0 extra load -> your case 0 requires hi>=8)
  0xE0C020D8  ldrd r2,r3,[r0],#8      (bit24=0 post-index extra load -> case 0 requires bit24)
  0xE16020F8  strd r2,r3,[r0,#-8]!    (bits23-20 = 6 -> hi>=8 fails)
  0xE320F002  wfe                     (hint imm4 != 0 -> case 1 mask 0x0FFF00FF requires imm4=0)
Each is a valid ARMv7 instruction emitted by clang -marm. My earlier message has the exact replacement masks; the two essential ones are:
  case 0: if ((insn & 0x0E000090u) == 0x00000090u) return n2a32_arm_mem;   /* BEFORE the bit24 test */
  case 3: if ((insn & 0x0FF000F0u) == 0x07F000F0u) return n2a32_arm_misc;   /* UDF */
          if ((insn & 0x10u) != 0) return n2a32_arm_media;
          return n2a32_arm_mem;
When your fix lands I will re-run the same snippets and post the result. No action needed on my class files.
